## 1.3.40 (HexGhoul): Home Living, part 1: the ghoul kitchen (66 foods with their own icons, recipes and effects), The Human, mutants, endless ghoul-meat growth, homes by biome (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.40 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 67**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, **not tried in game**.

- **The ghoul kitchen.** 66 new foods, each with its own hand-drawn 16x16 icon, a crafting recipe (shapeless) and a line about it in its tooltip. They mix human meat and ghoul meat with bread and vanilla foods. Every one counts as ghoul food, so a ghoul can eat all of them. Arranged by chapter (the cookbook, coming next, uses the same chapters):
  - *The Basics:* Human Meat, Seared Human Meat, Seared Ghoul Meat, Minced Human Meat, Bottled Blood, Blood Sugar Cubes, Blood Sausage, RC Broth.
  - *Breads and Sandwiches:* Seared Sandwich, Club Sandwich, Blood Toast, Steamed Meat Bun, Anteiku Burger, Sausage Roll, Ghoul Sandwich, Kakuja Burger, Flatbread Wrap.
  - *Bowls:* Human Stew, Crimson Risotto, Black Risotto, Meatballs in Red Sauce, Beet and Blood Soup, Midnight Ramen, RC Ramen, Crimson Curry, Centipede Soba, Red Hunger Stew, Tide Broth, Pumpkin Soup, Forest Blood Stew, Crimson Pudding.
  - *The Grill and the Plate:* Meat Skewer, Kagune Kebab, Steak Dinner, Honey-Glazed Ribs, Human Jerky, Human Tartare, Kakuhou Tartare, Akai Sushi, Kuro Sushi, Steamed Dumplings, Spring Rolls, Croquettes, Stuffed Potato, Sunday Omelette, Owl's Omelette, Morning Plate, Meatloaf, Roast Haunch, Meat Pie, Ghoul's Pie.
  - *Sweets:* Kakuja Cake, Blood Velvet Cake, Blood Cookies, Blood Jelly, Ghoul Mochi, Berry Blood Tart, Blood Pumpkin Pie, Blood Truffles, Golden Heart, Glow Berry Sorbet.
  - *Drinks:* Anteiku Blend, Blood Latte, Crimson Tea, RC Tonic, Kakuja Shot.
- **How they cook.** Raw Human Meat and Ghoul Meat sear in a furnace, smoker or on a campfire. Mincing human meat gives two. Bottled Blood (a glass bottle + human meat) goes into a lot of recipes and gives its bottle back when you craft with it. Bowl dishes hand you the bowl back once eaten, and drinks hand back their bottle. Drinks are drunk, not eaten. Snacks (sugar cubes, jerky, cookies, mochi, truffles) eat twice as fast, and drinks and snacks can be had on a full stomach. Bigger recipes make 2 to 8 servings.
- **They fill more and give boosts.** Most fill more than vanilla food. Every dish gives effects, shown in its tooltip with level and time: Strength, Night Vision ("see in the dark"), Speed, Haste, Regeneration, Resistance, Absorption, Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Jump Boost, and four new ones, each with its own icon:
  - **Refreshed:** your RC flows back on its own, 0.25 a second per level (the bar holds 100).
  - **Replenished:** wounds close slowly (half a heart every 4 s, twice as fast at level II), at no cost to your flesh reserve.
  - **Content** (happier): the frenzy ebbs every second, and anyone whose regard you win (companions, your spouse) warms to you 50% faster while it lasts.
  - **Clear Sight** (clearer vision): blindness, darkness and nausea fall away while it lasts, and you see three times as far under water, in lava and in powder snow.
- **Contains ghoul meat.** Every food made with ghoul meat says so in dark red in its tooltip (with the piece count if it's more than one), and is tagged `hexkagune:contains_ghoul_meat` (human-meat ones: `hexkagune:contains_human_meat`). For a ghoul, eating one devours those pieces exactly like eating raw Ghoul Meat, and the tooltip shows what you'd be at after. A human who eats one is sick, as with raw Ghoul Meat, and gets nothing else from it. Human meat, however it's cooked, gives no growth.
- **Ghoul-meat growth is now endless (and gentler).** There is no ceiling any more: each piece still adds a little less than the one before, but it never stops. Strength is +12% and RC lasts +25% per unit of ln(1 + pieces / 20). About +5% / x1.10 at 10 pieces, +21% / x1.45 at 100, +47% / x1.98 at 1000. It's weaker early than before (40 pieces used to be +25% / x1.63 and is now +13% / x1.27), but it keeps going where the old curve flattened at +40% / x2. Your saved piece count is kept, so only the numbers shown change.
- **Mutants.** A ghoul Eto has made one-eyed like her is a mutant. Their blows land 25% harder (on top of ghoul meat), every RC cost is divided by 1.6 so the bar drains far slower and holds that much more, and every bite of flesh fills 1.5 times as much of the reserve.
- **The Human.** A new NPC, only by command for now: `/summon hexkagune:human` (a structure for them comes later). It wears one of vanilla's own default skins (Steve, Alex, Ari, Efe, Kai, Makena, Noor, Sunny, Zuri; wide or slim) and wanders. It runs from wild ghouls, from a ghoul player with their kagune out (16 blocks), from a hidden ghoul who gets too close (6 blocks), and from anyone who hurts it. It runs at about a player's walking pace with its arms over its head, so a sprinting ghoul catches it easily. It drops 1 to 3 Human Meat (plus one per Looting level) and doesn't despawn.
- **Homes by biome.** Anteiku and the cyber tower now generate only in plains (and sunflower plains). The Library generates only in plains and forests (forest, flower, birch, old birch, dark forest). Each now gets three candidate spots on its ring instead of one, so a world without plains near a single spot still gets one. Any extra copy is an empty building: Touka, Ken and Eto are still one of each (a second body is sent away, as before). Only newly generated chunks are affected.

Not in this version (coming next in Home Living): Touka's cookbook and the trade for it, the illustrated book, your partner cooking these at home, and children inheriting their parents' kagune.

Untested in game: compiled and unit tested only. Try: `/summon hexkagune:human`, chase it, sear its meat, then craft through the Food & Drinks tab. Eat an RC Ramen as a ghoul and check the tooltip numbers. Drink a Crimson Tea and dive.
